output.objection: You are framing my cost constraint as a refusal to modernize, which ignores the real budget ceiling we operate under. I am asking you to acknowledge that manual steps are a deliberate trade for capital efficiency, not a failure of vision.
output.correction: I never said we should keep the pipeline manual forever; I said we need to prove the automation pays for itself before we spend the money. You filed this as a technical blocker when it is purely a financial decision point.
